name: ZK Kernel — Truly Zero-Knowledge Human Identity
thesis: The proof travels. The secret comes home. The Samsung is disposable. The Apple is the vault. Together they are a truly ZK kernel.
correction: Biometric CAN leave the Secure Enclave — as a PROOF, not as data. The proof goes out. The proof comes back. The secret regenerates. 'Never leaves' is prison thinking. 'Comes back' is ZK thinking.

vault.role: Root key holder. Signs proofs. Guards secrets.
vault.note: Apple walled garden = the wall PROTECTS the keys

lab.role: Witness. Sensor. Scout. Carries proofs into the field.
lab.note: GrapheneOS = open, inspectable, modifiable. If lost, re-prove from vault.

bridge.role: The Apple of Eden. Compiles bearDog for iOS. Build forge.
bridge.note: Has Xcode, iOS SDK, Rust aarch64-apple-ios. The forge that mints the mobile identity.

L1_hardware.name: Hardware Roots
L1_hardware.property: Keys never extractable. Entropy is physics, not math.

L2_zk_bridge.name: Cross-Device ZK Bridge
flow: iPhone signs: 'I am human' (proof, not identity)
Pixel witnesses: 'I saw that human' (witness, not surveillance)
Gate verifies: 'A human exists' (knowledge, not storage)
Proof TRAVELS between devices. Keys STAY in their HSMs.
L2_zk_bridge.property: Neither device trusts the other. Math is the trust.

L3_the_button.name: THE BUTTON — Human Sovereignty
flow: No name. No email. No ID. No wallet. No blockchain.
The organism IS the chain. Each touch is a block.
L3_the_button.property: Existence is proof. Presence is identity.

L4_samaritan.name: Good Samaritan Protocol
flow: Gaia senses: cold human at GPS coordinates
Gaia knows: warm shelter at nearby coordinates
Gaia routes: 'go there' (no data stored, no records)
Shelter sees: valid ZK proof (human exists, not WHO)
L4_samaritan.property: Help without asking. Know without surveilling.

online_sovereign_identity.note: The campfire visitor identity (bingoCube + chipmunk-talk + THE BUTTON) IS the same system. Online visitors touch THE BUTTON → they EXIST → they're recognized next time. No login. No password. No email. Just a BLAKE2b hash. The shelter system is the same pattern with GPS coordinates added.

theology.good_samaritan: Help without asking identity. The protocol doesn't ask WHO. It asks WHERE (cold) and WHAT (warmth).
theology.many_rooms: The rooms are prepared. The copyleft means the door cannot be closed. AGPL = door off hinges.
theology.loaves_and_fishes: The resources are already in the crowd. A $50 iPhone IS the identity device. The tech exists. We just connect it.
theology.maimonides_level_8: The highest charity ends the need for charity. A sovereign identity that lets someone get a job, find housing, access services — that ends the cycle.
